contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #001: Milne’s rationality conjecture and algebraic specialization.

Audit lem:admissible-realization in the staged October 7, 2026 manuscript: over a finite extension of K0=Frac W(Fpbar), an admissible filtration in the prescribed geometric J-cocharacter orbit must be realized by an abelian lift in the tensor isogeny class, using one algebraic quasi-isogeny with its exact crystalline marking and all prime-to-p tensors, including p=2.

definitions.strongly_admissible: Kisin-Zhou arXiv:2505.02165v1 Definition 2.1.6, with the adapted self-dual closed Hodge embedding of Proposition 2.1.9
definitions.tensor_isogeny_class: one algebraic quasi-isogeny preserving the canonical crystalline tensors and every prime-to-p tensor, not independently chosen local isomorphisms
definitions.admissible: the faithful filtered isocrystal is realized by a crystalline representation
definitions.scope: the realization lemma only; neither the balanced-Weil dichotomy nor the companion CM Hodge theorem is assumed proved

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 001 (Milne’s rationality conjecture and algebraic specialization.; papers: Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

Under exactly the hypotheses of lem:admissible-realization, including strongly admissible adapted Hodge datum, quasi-split J_Qp, a characteristic-zero lift of x, and an admissible geometric J-filtration, there exist after finite extension y in I_x, one tensor-preserving algebraic quasi-isogeny b:C_x->C_y, and a lift ytilde with b^*Fil^1 H_dR^1(C_ytilde)=F^1. The same b gives the crystalline marking and preserves all prime-to-p tensors, also at p=2.

For arbitrary groups and group homomorphisms, Frobenius-twisted change of basis is compatible with every Frobenius-equivariant representation, and a faithful homomorphism pulls central elements back to central elements. For every topological space, every indexed family of locally constant tensor-discrepancy maps vanishes everywhere if a single good-point set meets every connected component and all discrepancies vanish on that set.
The prescribed filtration determines a unique classical J-flag in the admissible locus, and after finite extension this flag has a framed point at the fixed parahoric level.

For the adapted strongly admissible Hodge embedding, the integral local Shimura variety is the tensor-compatible marked Siegel Rapoport-Zink pullback, with the canonical universal J-shtuka and abelian realization, also at p=2.

On this marked Rapoport-Zink pullback, the one universal special-fiber algebraic p-quasi-isogeny preserves every prime-to-p canonical tensor: its discrepancies modulo ell^n are locally constant, and the G(Qp) Hecke orbit of an initial lift meets every connected component. Its inverse is the Rapoport-Zink marking, so its pullback of the realized Hodge filtration is the prescribed period.
Weak admissibility together with the finite local-field descent stipulated in the manuscript implies admissibility, including residue characteristic two.

At p=2 the lattice with columns (1,1) and (0,2) is stable under every diag(1,1+2s), s in Z_2, but the rational idempotent diag(1,0) is not integral in this lattice. Consequently arbitrary stable-lattice selection does not supply the integral tensor hypothesis; this is not a counterexample to the manuscript, which chooses its lattice through a framed local Shimura point.

claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Equiv.Basic
import Mathlib.Topology.LocallyConstant.Basic

namespace PrescribedFiltration

theorem frobenius_basis_change {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (sigma : G →* G) (b g : G) :
    (sigma g)⁻¹ * sigma b * sigma (sigma g) =
      sigma (g⁻¹ * b * sigma g) := by
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv]

theorem representation_basis_change {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Group H]
    (sigma : G →* G) (tau : H →* H) (rho : G →* H)
    (compatible : ∀ a, tau (rho a) = rho (sigma a)) (b g : G) :
    (rho (sigma g))⁻¹ * rho (sigma b) * tau (rho (sigma g)) =
      rho (sigma (g⁻¹ * b * sigma g)) := by
  rw [compatible (sigma g)]
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv]

theorem faithful_central_preimage {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Group H]
    (rho : G →* H) (faithful : Function.Injective rho) (z : G)
    (central : ∀ a : H, rho z * a = a * rho z) :
    ∀ g : G, z * g = g * z := by
  intro g
  apply faithful
  simpa only [map_mul] using central (rho g)

theorem propagate_tensor_equalities {X I : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {A : I → Type*} (discrepancy : ∀ i, X → A i)
    (locallyConstant : ∀ i, IsLocallyConstant (discrepancy i))
    (zero : ∀ i, A i) (good : X → Prop)
    (hitsComponents : ∀ x : X,
      ∃ y : X, y ∈ connectedComponent x ∧ good y)
    (goodValues : ∀ y : X, good y →
      ∀ i : I, discrepancy i y = zero i) :
    ∀ i : I, ∀ x : X, discrepancy i x = zero i := by
  intro i x
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hgood⟩ := hitsComponents x
  calc
    discrepancy i x = discrepancy i y :=
      (locallyConstant i).apply_eq_of_isPreconnected
        isPreconnected_connectedComponent mem_connectedComponent hy
    _ = zero i := goodValues y hgood i

end PrescribedFiltration

claims.natural_statement: Manuscript thm:main: every rational Hodge class on a good-reduction abelian variety has one rational pairing with each prescribed complementary product of special-fiber divisors, common to every ell-adic realization and crystalline realization, for every prime.
Manuscript cor:cm-transport: after a power, one special-fiber quasi-isogeny to a CM good-reduction abelian variety transports the rational Hodge class with one equality in all realizations.

Manuscript prop:transport(2): a weakly admissible filtration with the stated finite local-field tensor descent and geometric G-orbit can be realized on the auxiliary abelian variety with the prescribed repeated marked filtration and simultaneous normalized Hodge-tensor transport.

Manuscript lem:auxiliary-datum: the isotypic restriction-of-scalars enlargement produces a quasi-split strongly admissible auxiliary Hodge datum, with a self-dual closed integral embedding, at every prime.

Manuscript 02_transport.tex:713-775: the local polarization similitude scalars all equal one rational ratio of divisor intersection numbers, and the transported codimension-r class scales by the r-th power of this same rational scalar.

Manuscript thm:filtration: the specified CM action, polarization and invertible Rosati-self-adjoint conjugate-linear endomorphism admit an E- and u-stable balanced Lagrangian weakly admissible filtration with finite local-field descent, testing every subisocrystal including Frobenius-permuted embedding blocks.

Manuscript prop:weil: balanced Weil specializations are orthogonal to all complementary Lefschetz classes when U has no invertible element, and are simultaneous rational Lefschetz classes when U has an invertible element.

Manuscript lem:weil-orthogonality: absence of an invertible Rosati-self-adjoint E-conjugate-linear special-fiber endomorphism forces all complementary Lefschetz pairings of specialized balanced Weil classes to vanish.

Manuscript lem:weil-group: the balanced determinant-similitude group is connected reductive and of Hodge type, acts transitively on the relevant geometric polarized balanced flags, and gives the required determinant multiplier for Weil classes.

Manuscript lem:weil-divisor-span: on a rational projector summand of E-rank 2s, a rational divisor separately nondegenerate on every E-eigenspace makes the rational pure determinant subspace consist of rational Lefschetz classes, with rational descent of coefficients.

Manuscript lem:lift-hom: a specified rational algebraic special-fiber homomorphism preserving the crystalline Hodge filtration lifts uniquely to a rational homomorphism of the abelian schemes; symmetry and finite algebraic identities are preserved.

Manuscript lem:cm-reduction: every positive-codimension rational Hodge class on a good-reduction CM abelian variety is a finite rational sum of pullbacks of balanced Weil classes on good-reduction rational-idempotent factors of powers, simultaneously after specialization.
Manuscript lem:pairing-functorial: rational homomorphism pullback preserves the simultaneous rational Lefschetz pairing property.

Unverified external companion assertion used only for the manuscript algebraic-specialization consequence: every rational Hodge class on a CM abelian variety is algebraic. This claim is not assumed proved in this audit or used in PF-REALIZATION.

Manuscript cor:algebraic-specialization: one rational cycle on the special fiber represents every specialization component of a rational Hodge class. The manuscript deduction uses CM transport and the separate unverified companion CM Hodge assertion, not just the realization lemma.

routes.retired_because: Admissibility determines rational data, not integral tensor frames on an arbitrary stable lattice. The exact p=2 projector obstruction PF-LATTICE-OBSTRUCTION kills this shortcut; it does not refute the framed-point construction or the manuscript lemma.

This decomposition incorrectly put geometric realization before rational admissibility. Weak-admissible descent uses Colmez-Fontaine directly and is logically prior to PF-REALIZATION; the corrected proof is Step 6 of realization_proof.md.
